races.title: Ascot Shared Ownership Weekend Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: THE WALK made a taking start to his hurdling career at Ffos Las a month ago and bred to stay well, he can improve for this step up in trip and repeat the feat of a year ago and win at this meeting again. Point recruit Vedivici may offer most resistance, ahead of Katarcice . THE WALK (IRE) VEDIVICI (FR) KATARCICE (FR)
races.bettingForecast: The Walk (9/4), Katarcice (3/1), Handmedownastar (4/1), Vedivici (9/2), Jet Bay (13/2), Ar Aghaidh Leat (14/1), Ava's Friend Bill (50/1)

races.title: Ladbrokes 1965 Chase (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: STEEL ALLY may have more to offer up in trip this season and makes the most appeal hailing from a yard that does well with reappearing runners. Master Chewy made an encouraging return at Aintree and is the pick for the forecast. STEEL ALLY (FR) MASTER CHEWY (IRE) BLOW YOUR WAD (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Lulamba (8/15), Steel Ally (11/8), Blow Your Wad (2/1), Doyen Quest (10/3), Master Chewy (8/1)

races.title: Ladbrokes Ascot Hurdle (Grade 2) (Registered As The Ascot Hurdle) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: KATEIRA showed she retains plenty of speed when scoring at Wetherby last time, and Dan Skelton's smashing mare can gain a deserved first success in Grade 2 company. Lucky Place is most likely to get the run of things and may edge Altobelli for second. KATEIRA LUCKY PLACE (FR) ALTOBELLI (IRE)

races.title: Ladbrokes Get Your Free Racing Bet Today Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: PORTER IN THE PARK is lurking on a dangerous mark and can go 2 places better than in last year's renewal of this race. The main danger could be Easy Love , who is relatively unexposed in handicaps, while That's Nice is entitled to be in the mix if on another going day. Likeable mare Love of Neymore deserves an honourable mention in an open-looking event. PORTER IN THE PARK (IRE) EASY LOVE (IRE) THAT'S NICE (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: That's Nice (11/4), Love Of Neymore (5/1), Smugglers Haven (11/2), Popova (6/1), Porter In The Park (15/2), Easy Love (8/1), Letterston Lady (10/1), Miss Goldfire (10/1), Jalisco Star (20/1), Betty's Daisy (33/1)

races.title: Restorations UK Berkshire National Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: OUR POWER confirmed that he still has lots to offer when only narrowly denied at Sandown to end last season and he remains 1 lb below his last winning mark. He can pick up where he left off to return to winning ways, though Rock My Way isn't taken lightly in his bid to land this prize for the second year running. Mt Fugi Park completes the shortlist. OUR POWER (IRE) ROCK MY WAY (IRE) MT FUGI PARK (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Rock My Way (11/4), Our Power (3/1), Brandt (5/1), Henry's Friend (6/1), Ballycamus (8/1), Mt Fugi Park (12/1), Hold Your Fort (14/1), Sound And Fury (14/1), My Gift To You (20/1)

races.title: Vietti Barolo Hurst Park Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: VANDERPOEL took his form up to a smart level when making a successful return over C&D 3 weeks ago and, with further improvement likely in his second season over fences, he is fancied to follow up. Shakeyatailfeather is feared most with conditions promising to suit, while Calico also gives Dan Skelton a strong hand. VANDERPOEL (IRE) SHAKEYATAILFEATHER (IRE) CALICO (GER)
races.bettingForecast: Vanderpoel (6/4), Ryan's Rocket (11/2), Martator (6/1), Shakeyatailfeather (6/1), Calico (7/1), Sans Bruit (8/1), Gabriel's Getaway (12/1)

races.title: Ascot Advent Calendar Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Preference is for HERBYGOESBANANAS , who opened his hurdles account in good style at Worcester at the beginning of the month. He gets the vote ahead of handicap debutant Baile An Or , with Mr Rafiki another to consider arriving on the back of a breakthrough victory. HERBYGOESBANANAS BAILE AN OR (IRE) MR RAFIKI (IRE)
